decisions.reason: As a newly launched core industrial unit shown on its own webpage, it reflects visible investment and a close fit with the firm's application-technology strategy, so management would be inclined to continue it.
This product also appears to be a strategically relevant resin-injection unit with public commitment behind it, and with no clear evidence of failure management would likely persist.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's established spray-equipment business, so recent launch costs and public presentation make withdrawal unlikely so soon.

Because this manual airless spray gun is closely tied to the firm's traditional offering and was explicitly marketed, management would likely justify staying the course rather than admitting an early mistake.
As a full product line with several models in a core spray-gun category, it likely required broader investment and commitment, which strongly favors retention under escalation of commitment.

Although the data logger is somewhat more peripheral than the core guns and pumping equipment, it still supports the firm's innovation direction and public launch, so management would probably keep it for now.
